en: Sepia-toned postcard reproduction of a large Gothic-style mural or altarpiece inside an ornate hall. The upper part shows a dramatic narrative scene framed by pointed arches: on the left, a man restrains a young figure while a kneeling woman pleads; on the right, a cloaked figure climbs a steep wall outside, with tall medieval buildings and a moonlit sky in the background. The lower portion shows a richly patterned frieze and a row of intricately carved high-backed wooden chairs lining the wall, suggesting a ceremonial or council chamber. The overall ambience is medieval and Central European.
